explication: OpenResearch is a local-first research-agent workspace, exposed through a desktop app and the `orx` CLI. Users set up an agent, work in a project, ground hypotheses in literature, and launch experiments; runs may execute locally or on configured compute, with results and artifacts retained in the local store for inspection. The map preserves the documented research, agent, compute, and experiment-memory capabilities. Some large command and runtime modules were not sampled, so uncertain internal connections are omitted or marked unverified.
